deviations.title: Configurable native character progression
deviations.why: User requested intuitive base/growth controls without replacing class mechanics.
deviations.how: Optional base/growthPercent/growthFlat profiles augment native curves; classed allocated points remain separate. Empty profiles keep original behavior. Balance v2 accepts v1; previews do not save or publish.

deviations.title: Global game balancing
deviations.why: User clarified durable whole-game tuning, not a current-character/session editor.
deviations.how: #dashboard writes game-balance.json (player/potential percent + flat, future EXP gain, global/template effective equipment options) and monster-tuning.json. Existing and future objects use these rules without rewriting raw player allocations/item options. Protected API, explicit save/reset, read-only previews and normal protocol refresh. Compile-only validation; user handles runtime debugging.

deviations.title: Dark workbench and larger typography
deviations.why: User requested dark mode, larger and heavier text, and Apple fonts.
deviations.how: Dark default, one Apple-first system UI font stack with Segoe UI fallback across all text including code/JSON/IDs, 15-17px reading text. No font downloads or external services; browser QA left to user.

deviations.title: Mouse wheel units
deviations.why: Input System normalized notches were divided by 120 again, rounding scrolling to zero.
deviations.how: Bridge honors scrollDeltaBehavior; divide only native Windows units by 120. Existing WheelStepPx remains 24; user verifies hardware scrolling.

deviations.title: Render-rate notification text
deviations.why: User reported stepped scrolling MP-full text.
deviations.how: Info/InfoMe interpolate text placement under Smooth Effects; preserve original timing and fixed clipping. Final revision compile-only verified; user handles visual debugging.

deviations.title: Fractional world and list-content painting
deviations.notes: Original client paints integer positions at low logic rate. Extend existing Interp snapshots and scoped GUI transforms across world renderers; nested projectiles replace parent residuals. Scroll hit-testing and logic offsets remain unchanged; viewport/origin/paint cleanup restores transforms. Map transitions/teleports snap. No sprite frame synthesis or gameplay timing change.

deviations.title: Release manual ground movement without friction delay
deviations.notes: Original client Char.updateCharRun decreases cvx by one per tick: observed 9 ticks/0.375 s and 36 extra pixels at speed 8. Keyboard arrow/number-pad and pointer movement release now request an immediate stop; configurable in Inspector. Movement speed, airborne motion and destination paths unchanged.

deviations.title: Persistent configurable offline loot gates
deviations.notes: User requested web settings. Per-world immutable validated policy replaces active hardcoded gates; defaults retain prior behavior and Java probabilities. No player/static/reference file writes.

deviations.title: Render-time effect interpolation and popup/HP transitions
deviations.notes: Original client GameScr updateFlyText/updateSplash, Menu updateMenu, Mob paint remain logic-owned. Fractional painting adds intermediate positions and visual HP easing; recently reopened menus get a minimum opening instead of snapping. Server damage and effect lifetimes unchanged.

deviations.title: All loot blocked at 10-level overlevel gap
deviations.notes: User decision 2026-11-11: block quest items, ordinary items/currency and sushi at >=10 levels below player. Dummy exclusion matches Java and also covers sushi. Original ordinary-loot seven-level gate remains.

deviations.title: Unity render/logic skill timing
deviations.notes: Original client Char.updateSkillPaint/setAttack uses exact hit-frame equality. Offline Unity timing uses >= with one dispatch per cast before cleanup because rendering can skip the exact frame between logic ticks. Damage/range/cooldown unchanged.

deviations.how: NaturalRegenPercent defaults to 0; old positive branch is opt-in only. Food/potion/equipment remain unchanged.

deviations.title: Khung chat là terminal lệnh dev

No public chat offline.
